text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Does Lady <chrname> engage in 
such rigorous training on a regular basis?
choice_data_list:
Yes, it's a routine tailored specifically 
for her.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? 
Truly... even the present day holds such 
fascinating wonders.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For a while after that, she continued 
watching 
<chrname>'s training with great curiosity.
